[[File:Chopper.png|thumb|250px|Chopper]] '''Chopper''' (Japanese: '''マサ''' ''Masa'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP036|The Bridge Bike Gang]]''. He is a member of a {{tc|Biker}} gang who have claimed [[Kanto Route 17|Cycling Road]] as their territory. They {{pkmn|battle}} {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who are traveling across the bridge. Chopper and [[Tyra]], another biker, are old friends of [[Jessie]] and [[James]], as they were members of the bike gang before they decided to join [[Team Rocket]]. Chopper entered into a battle with {{Ash}}, and while his {{p|Golem}} was able to defeat his {{AP|Bulbasaur}}, it was defeated by [[Ash's Charmander]]. After the battle, Ash and {{ashfr}} continued across the bridge to [[Sunnytown]], attempting to deliver medicine to a sick {{p|Shellder}}. However, Chopper and the other bikers stopped them, wanting to battle. When Ash declined, saying he was trying to deliver medicine to a sick Pokémon, Chopper was impressed that Ash would brave dangerous weather to help a Pokémon. He and the other bikers escorted the kids to the [[Pokémon Center]]. Chopper, impressed with Ash's bravery, announced that the gang would dub him "Awesome Ash". ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} This listing is of Chopper's known Pokémon: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Chopper |pkmn=Golem |type1=Rock |type2=Ground |img=Chopper Golem.png |epnum=EP036 |epname=The Bridge Bike Gang |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Golem}} was the Pokémon that Chopper chose to use during his battle against Ash. Ash first summoned {{AP|Bulbasaur}} and had it use {{m|Vine Whip}}, but that proved to be useless against Golem's shell. Golem then defeated Bulbasaur with a single Tackle. Ash [[recall]]ed Bulbasaur and sent {{AP|Charmander}} out in its place. He used {{m|Ember}}, but {{DL|Type|Type effectiveness|Golem was unaffected}}. The {{pkmn|category|Megaton Pokémon}} then attacked with Rock Throw, but Charmander dodged and attacked with {{m|Flamethrower}} and {{m|Fire Spin}} in succession, covering Golem's body with flames. Golem attempted to Tackle Charmander but just ended up rolling amongst the bike gang as a red-hot ball of fire, forcing Chopper to recall it. Even after the battle, Golem's {{i|Poké Ball}} was so hot that Chopper almost burned his fingers while holding it. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[EP105|Charizard Chills]]''.
